newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes firmer, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes firmer, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate ended firmer on Friday, but dealers did not expect further rises as liquidity remained stable in the banking system.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.203 percent against Thursday's 5.136 finish, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.05-5.10 against 5.00-5.10.
Several major banks have adopted a cautious policy ahead of the new year holiday, pushing the interbank rate slightly higher, dealers said, but they added the rate should stay stable next week.
The bond market was quiet in the afternoon amid slugglish sentiment as reported hikes in domestic oil prices triggered inflation worries, dealers said.
